versions.localizedDescription: Bot list hover, ⌘E menu, categories on desktop + host-owned sync, All sessions…, log viewer parity and working sort, idle bot faces no longer animate.

Phase 6a — one window language.

• Every sheet and menu now shares the app's own chrome: the same canvas behind it, the same dark appearance, and the same rounded corners as a card. No more black sheet next to a grey one, or a Mac sheet following the system theme while the window behind it is dark.
• Nothing changes about what any sheet does — only how it sits in the app.

Phase 5 — the soul a new bot starts from, and a backup that can rebuild your roster.

• Settings → Bots (Mac) / Settings → Bots (phone): set the instructions every new bot begins with. Leave it empty and new bots start from Hermes's own default; 'Reset' does the same thing.
• Export writes one JSON file with every bot's name, description, soul, memory, notes, categories and routines — no conversations. Restore reads it back on this or a fresh install: it creates bots that are missing, fills in documents that are empty, and never overwrites a bot's own words. Restored routines start running after the host restarts.

Phase 4 complete — tap a bot-to-bot message to see the exchange between the two bots.

• Tapping 'Message from …' on a bot-to-bot message opens the conversation between those two bots: both directions, oldest first, each with the sender's face and time.
• Nothing else changes in how you'd use the apps.

Phase 4 — search inside the conversations, and bot-to-bot messages drawn as people.

• Search now finds what was said, not just bot names: results show which bot, who wrote it, when, and the line around the match. Bot-name matches still come after them.
• A message from another bot is drawn with that bot's face and 'Message from …' above the words, instead of appearing as something you typed. Older messages written before this change read correctly too.
